key_insight: AI is positioned as a unifying tool to diagnose, explain, predict, and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites across multiple degradation pathways.
engineering_relevance: The review highlights AI-guided strategies that can improve device reliability and accelerate stability engineering for perovskite solar cells and related optoelectronic devices.
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes multimodal, protocol-dependent, and sparse stability data, motivating AI methods that can handle uncertainty and coupled degradation processes.
watch_item: Current AI approaches are limited by inconsistent protocols, weak benchmarks, and poor transferability across datasets and domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
